scope: Reusable across products, suppliers, countries and cases

rules.rule: Separate seller, contracting/payment entity, legal manufacturer, physical site, exact SKU or batch, and target process.
Represent conclusions as role x component x site/process claims.
Image matches, brands, listings, patents, licence holders and shippers are leads, not manufacturing proof.
Not publicly found never means nonexistent or not manufactured.
Deduplicate common-source evidence by independence group.
Preserve originals and lineage before transformation.
Bind capability evidence to exact site, SKU/batch and process.
AI and visual similarity outputs are hypothesis generators and are not evidence eligible.
ESS is not a statistically calibrated probability.
Only a fresh confirmed audit permits a confirmed target-process manufacturer statement.
Parallel lanes must use an exclusive write root and one reconciler for canonical merge.
